notes: EXIT button (Windows): top-left on the game screen and on the results card. Press it twice to quit.
Bigger cities: every board now has extra blocks of buildings filling the open ground.

The city stays beat up: the next onslaught starts on the damaged city and it gets worse every run. It only starts over with the RESET CITY button, or automatically once it is 95% demolished. A CITY % DEMOLISHED counter shows how far along it is.
Railgun toned down: lower impact, and every flight loses energy as it breaks more, so one shot no longer clears half a city.
Everything from v16 is included: controller SELECT button (default A), modular-building towns, cars and pedestrians, movable launcher, 180 degree aim, Windows PC version.
